<section class="mission">
  <div class="wrap mission-grid">
    <div>
      <h1>I am a physicist at the University of the Basque Country. I work on <strong>the structure of solids, the thermal radiation of materials, and how physics is taught</strong>.</h1>
      <p class="who">Full Professor of Physics at the Faculty of Science and Technology in Leioa, on its staff since 1988 and a doctor since 1994. Thirty years of diffraction, calorimetry and phase transitions in perovskites; a decade in the Thermomat group, which I co-lead, measuring the infrared emissivity of materials for energy with the HAIRL radiometer; and, every year since 2011, the course on thermodynamics and statistical physics, in Basque, with its notebooks, its simulations and its bachelor's theses.</p>
      <p class="quicklinks"><a href="research/index.html">Research lines</a><span class="sep">&middot;</span><a href="publications/index.html">Publications</a><span class="sep">&middot;</span><a href="theses/index.html">Theses</a><span class="sep">&middot;</span><a href="teaching/index.html">Teaching</a><span class="sep">&middot;</span><a href="mailto:josu.igartua@ehu.eus">Contact</a></p>

<section class="home-section" id="research">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head"><h2>Research</h2><a class="more" href="research/index.html">The five lines &rarr;</a></div>
    <p class="sec-intro">Four lines in the physics of materials, from adiabatic calorimetry through pseudosymmetry and double perovskites to infrared emissivity, and a fifth on how physics is learned. Nineteen experiments at European large facilities, forty-odd competitive projects and recognised groups, and the contracts with industry, all listed.</p>
    <div class="lines">
      <div class="line-item"><div class="num">01</div><h3><a href="research/index.html#structure">Structure and phase transitions in perovskites</a></h3><p>Crystal structures and structural phase transitions of simple, double and triple perovskite oxides, and of ferroic crystals, by adiabatic calorimetry, Raman and infrared spectroscopy, X-ray and neutron powder diffraction and symmetry-mode analysis. A parametrised refinement protocol that makes laboratory X-ray data do work that used to need a synchrotron.</p><div class="caps">mode crystallography &middot; AMPLIMODES &middot; ILL, ESRF, SINQ &middot; five doctoral theses</div></div>
      <div class="line-item"><div class="num">02</div><h3><a href="research/index.html#radiation">Thermal radiative properties of materials</a></h3><p>Within Thermomat / HAIRL: high-accuracy, angle-resolved spectral emissivity over wide spectral and temperature ranges, uncertainty budgets, temperature control of the emissometer, FAIR reporting of the measurements and the EKHI open database, for concentrated solar power, fusion materials, advanced steels and coated surfaces.</p><div class="caps">HAIRL radiometer &middot; EKHI &middot; fer framework &middot; two doctoral theses in progress</div></div>
      <div class="line-item"><div class="num">03</div><h3><a href="research/index.html#teaching">Computation in physics education</a></h3><p>Jupyter notebooks as the laboratory notebook of a theory course, MinervaLab for phase transitions, teaching materials in Basque, and the analysis of how students actually perform: from the course's own data to the physics entrance examination across Spain.</p><div class="caps">CSEDU, GIREP, RSEF &middot; MinervaLab &middot; PAU Física</div></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
